subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should OpenClaw own `service.instance.id` through a canonical bounded runtime identity, rely on standard OTel resource attributes, or permanently support this dedicated config and environment override?
rationale: These choices define different public compatibility contracts, precedence rules, privacy properties, and cross-signal behavior; implementation details alone cannot safely select the permanent product direction.

options.title: Canonical runtime identity
options.body: Expose an approved bounded OpenClaw instance identifier through the plugin runtime and use it consistently across all signals and SDK modes.

options.title: Standard OTel attributes
options.body: Document `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` as the operator-controlled identity path without adding a parallel OpenClaw config key.

options.title: Dedicated override
options.body: Approve `serviceInstanceId` and its environment fallback with explicit precedence, metadata coverage, privacy limits, and preloaded-mode scope.

recommendation.title: Canonical runtime identity
recommendation.body: Expose an approved bounded OpenClaw instance identifier through the plugin runtime and use it consistently across all signals and SDK modes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical requirements and are the clearest evidence-backed owner for the identity-source and privacy decision.
